name: layout4
description: cozy retro cottagecore polaroid collage. Analyze the outfit from the uploaded image and extract the dominant color palette and aesthetic vibe — use these to define the entire layout's accent color and decorative elements. Warm, cream, and rust tones as base with soft indoor cozy lighting; adapt the primary accent color to match the outfit's dominant or secondary hue (e.g. red/burgundy outfit → keep warm red accents; pastel/floral outfit → swap to matching flower tone; green/earthy outfit → sage or olive accents; blue outfit → dusty blue or slate accents; neutral/cream outfit → keep original red-and-cream theme). Background is a textured pegboard/perforated metal surface in muted taupe-grey tone — adapt accent colors and small decorative doodles to match the dominant color or motif of the outfit. The layout contains 3 polaroid-style photo slots: one large polaroid upper-center showing upper body, one large polaroid lower-left showing upper body, one smaller polaroid lower-right showing close-up face or detail. Decorative elements include a vintage communication or retro object cutout in upper-left and lower-right corners — detect the outfit vibe and choose a fitting retro prop (e.g. cozy/cottagecore outfit → rotary telephone; soft feminine/girly outfit → vintage vanity mirror or music box; dark academic outfit → typewriter or inkwell; Y2K/playful outfit → old TV set or cassette tape; sporty/casual outfit → retro radio or polaroid camera), brown teddy bear plush (lower-right, hugged by subject), binder clips attaching polaroids, hand-drawn doodles (spiral swirls, hearts, arrow lines) scattered across background in the detected accent color, text badge 'outfit of the day' on torn paper scraps center-middle. Warm analog color grade, vintage cozy atmosphere. Follow the exact number, shape, and arrangement of photo slots shown in the layout reference.
swipe_cta: Add a small vintage film-caption or retro label containing a short swipe-related CTA (such as 'Swipe →' or another concise variation). Keep the wording minimal and integrate it naturally using typewriter-style text, tiny arrows, paper clips, or retro doodle elements — color the accents to match the detected outfit palette rather than a fixed red.
